title: A Lonely Place to Die

ai_content.desc_en: In a world where power and strength reign supreme, two men from different backgrounds meet in a battle for life and death. One man is gravely injured, the other is left for dead, and the third is forced to confront his own mortality. In this battle, each man discovers himself, and becomes either a killer or a victim.
